summary: WebRTC test coverage now includes screen and tab sharing telemetry, rejected display-capture requests, immutable RTCSessionDescription fields, ML-KEM key-share defaults, and dependency-descriptor RTP signaling for received video. New tests cover Video Orientation RTP signaling and reception, early-media reoffers with MID-only demultiplexing, and rejected play() promises, helping Firefox handle real-world call setup and media controls more consistently.
